action.objective: Develop the bishop to b5 with check, then continue kingside development and contest the center.
action.rationale: f1b5 is the only commit_ready move. Verification completed at depth 4 (exact score -11, PV Bb5+ c6 Be2 Bf5), safety complete with no immediate mate or tactical refutation. The check is a real forcing device: Black must address it, typically c7c6 or a knight/bishop block, which gains time. Note the score turned slightly negative at deeper depth, reflecting that Black equalizes comfortably; the move is sound development, not a winning edge. Other top candidates from broad search (a2a3 etc.) were bound=upper at only depth 2 with no verification, so they cannot be preferred. I commit the verified move.
